subject: 📄 Verified Transcript — $student_name ($student_id)
body:
Dear $recipient_name,

$student_name (Student ID $student_id) has authorised the University to share a verified copy of their final academic transcript with $employer_name. Access details are below.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TRANSCRIPT ACCESS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Student:           $student_name ($student_id)
Programme:         $program_name
Classification:    $classification
Academic Year(s):  $academic_year
Freeze Reference:  $freeze_reference
Access Token:      $access_token
Expires:           $expires_at
Verification URL:  $verification_url

Purpose declared by requester: $purpose

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HOW TO VERIFY

  • Open the verification URL above and enter the access token when prompted.
  • The link is single-use; if it is consumed and you still need the data, ask the student to authorise a fresh release.
  • The transcript page shows a SHA-256 fingerprint; cross-check it against the value the student provides separately to defeat tampering.

DATA INTEGRITY

The transcript was frozen at conferral on $frozen_at — no subsequent edit is possible without leaving an audit trail. If the document you see in your browser doesn't match the student's claims, contact transcripts@university.edu immediately.

DATA PROTECTION

Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you may use this transcript solely for the declared purpose ($purpose). It must not be retained beyond your recruitment decision or shared with parties outside your organisation without further consent from the student.

Kind regards,
University Transcripts Office
